positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Every food and beverage company quietly pays a tax that never shows up on the P&L. Three teams email the same suppliers independently. No one sees what came back. Specs get buried. Certs expire. Margins erode invisibly. 15+ technology companies have tried to fix this — every one asked suppliers to log into a portal. Suppliers said no. Waystation took a different approach: suppliers don't know we exist, and that's the point. We turn the emails your team is already sending into structured, searchable procurement intelligence — no behavior change, no portals, no integration tax. Built by a team with 20 years in CPG, a decade building AI for the industry, and deep roots in procurement technology and engineering. Purpose-built for the way this industry actually works.
